id: title:jabahamondes:show engagement in the new dashboard

review.posthog_relevance: Adds an 'Engagement' section to the Marketing Analytics Dashboard, displaying session duration and bounce rate alongside existing acquisition metrics while retaining the shared Web Overview query and its filters.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized frontend implementation and documentation update. P1.F2.H2 removes the single 'Acquisition' section and replaces it with a dynamic mapping creating an 'Engagement' section, while P1.F1.H1 documents this behavior. No backend, query, or shared dependency changes are supplied. This does not demonstrate a broader capability or systemic risk reduction,;
review.uncertainty: The tier is established solely on the basis of the supplied observations, which are limited to frontend and documentation. No backend or query changes are supplied, so the tier cannot be established. No tier.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and frontend implementation. No backend, query, or shared dependency changes are supplied, so the tier cannot be established. No tier.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: P1.F1.H1 adds a paragraph stating that the Engagement section displays session duration and bounce rate from the same Web Overview response, sharing filters and not adding an extra query.
observations.code_quote: Engagement displays session duration and bounce rate from the same Web Overview response as Acquisition. Both sections share date, comparison and test-account filters; rendering Engagement adds no extra query.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the dashboard behavior and performance characteristic for PostHog users and documentation readers.

observations.behavior: Frontend implementation: P1.F2.H2 removes the single 'Acquisition' section and replaces it with a dynamic mapping that creates two sections, 'Acquisition' and 'Engagement', each with its own set of metric keys, while P1.F2.H1 removes the now-unused items variable.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds the Engagement section to the Marketing Analytics Dashboard, displaying session duration and bounce rate alongside existing acquisition metrics, while retaining the shared Web Overview query and its filters.
